answer: One enforceable rule: split emission across embedding clusters rather than paying per address. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The lagoon of work and the jade of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a timber to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
